gate: U8 the authored UV1 as Unreal exports it (0 overlapping px at 64 / 128)
cause: First run (/Game/GunCheck/SR01_1014a and earlier): Unreal stores static-mesh render UVs as half floats (Use Full Precision UVs off, the default). UV1 corners closer than one float16 step crossed after the rounding: 1 px of overlap at 128 px on SM_SR01_LOD0 (12 px at 1024) where the shipped float32 UV1 had none.
fix: Generator: Scripts/guns/sniper/sr_lodlib.py half_uv1() snaps UV1 to the float16 grid after every static join (sr_game.py twin LOD0-3, sr_attach.py magazine + scope LODs) and collapses any polygon that still overlaps (qa_check's SAT rule) to a zero-area UV1 at its own centre. Re-exported with run_rig_mag.sh --from game (qa_check before each export). Run SR01_1014b: 0 px at 64 and 128 on every LOD of SM_SR01 and SM_SR01_Mag (1024 px is reported only: 4 / 19 / 1 / 0 px on SM_SR01 LOD0-3).

gate: U10 asset warnings (static meshes: 'nearly zero bi-normals')
cause: The LOD UV-overlap rule collapsed the smaller triangle of each overlapping pair to a single point (zero area). A zero-area UV triangle gets no MikkTSpace frame, so Unreal logged a 'nearly zero bi-normals' warning on the static twin and the scope LODs (the SK route already repaired these with gunlib's fix_collapsed_uvs).
fix: Generator: sr_lodlib.fix_uv_overlaps now shrinks each such triangle to a 9e-7 speck in its own UV orientation (winding kept; 2 x area below qa_check's 1e-12 ignore limit), not a point. 0 point-collapsed UV triangles in the shipped bytes; U10 = 0 warning lines in every pass log.

gate: C2 every LOD0 surface sample inside the stored hulls
cause: The analysis did it, not the asset: Unreal stores SM_SR01's 10 hulls with the shipped vertices (hull 02: same 24 points, 0.0 mm both ways; hull 05 stores 22 of the 23 points, worst 0.007 mm). Blender's bmesh convex hull of hull 02's near-coplanar cluster gave a sliver face with a flipped normal, and that wrong plane put 9,498 of 320,744 samples 52.7 mm 'outside'.
fix: Harness: srD_analyse.planes() keeps a face plane only if no hull vertex lies in front of it (a true supporting plane). C2 = 0 outside on SM_SR01 (320,744 samples), SM_SR01_Mag and the scope. No asset change was needed: the hulls (sr_game / sr_lodlib.hull_safe) were already right.

gate: U6 reload clips in engine (the magazine on the posed SR01 at every runtime frame)
cause: Frame 2 of A_SR01_Reload / ReloadEmpty (paddle at -3.33 of its -4.5 deg release, magazine seated) has 8 catch/magazine triangle pairs touching: the catch nose leaving the notch. Blender's M8 reports the same frame and F5 allows it up to the engagement (worst 0.124 mm). The first engine depth (4.74 mm) used the nearest-face normal sign, which gunlib's depth_inside docstring warns calls points beyond an edge 'inside' (the notch is a concave pocket).
fix: Harness: srD_analyse measures the depth the F5 way (dense 0.25 mm samples of the meeting triangles, inside by ray parity, gunlib.gateutil.depth_inside), and srF holds U6 to Blender's F5 rule (catch-only frames, depth <= the F5 worst + 0.005 mm). Engine depth 0.088 mm <= 0.124 mm: pass. Nothing else meets the magazine on any frame.
